verdict.rationale: The docs describe point-in-time snapshots of sandbox directories stored in R2 that can be restored later, which covers the core snapshot/restore flow. However, the scope is directory-level, not a full sandbox image, and nothing shows forking new sandboxes from a snapshot. Missing for 10: whole-sandbox snapshots (process/memory/full filesystem state), documented forking of new sandboxes from a snapshot, in-depth API docs beyond one-line summaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
